name: Mage Darius
summary: Mage Darius is an emissary stationed outside the looming gates of Karazhan in Deadwind Pass. Representing the Violet Eye, he monitors the magical disruptions emanating from Medivh's ancient sanctuary.

sections.title: Watcher at the Gates
sections.body: Standing before the ominous threshold of Karazhan, Mage Darius serves as an outpost observer for the Violet Eye, a secretive sect of Kirin Tor spellcasters dedicated to monitoring Medivh's enigmatic tower. Deadwind Pass is a desolate, haunted corridor of twisted magic, and Darius keeps a wary vigil against the chaotic forces churning within the fortress walls.

sections.title: The Violet Eye's Task
sections.body: The Kirin Tor has long feared the lingering sorceries inside Karazhan following the demise of the Last Guardian. Darius acts as a field contact for intrepid adventurers braving the pass, evaluating those capable of resisting the arcane taint and rewarding allies who assist the Violet Eye in containing the tower's restless threats.

faq.answer: Darius is a human spellcaster stationed outside Karazhan in Deadwind Pass, acting on behalf of the Violet Eye to observe the tower and aid travelers who assist their investigation.
The Violet Eye is a dedicated, secretive contingent of the Kirin Tor formed specifically to spy on Karazhan and safeguard Azeroth from the perilous magical anomalies left behind by Medivh.

faq.q: Why is Darius standing in Deadwind Pass?
faq.answer: He maintains an encampment right outside Karazhan's gates to keep watch over the stronghold, study the unstable magical surges leaking out, and coordinate with adventurers investigating the ruins.

faq.q: Is Darius affiliated with the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: As an operative of the Kirin Tor's Violet Eye, Darius focuses on neutralizing arcane perils rather than factional conflict, interacting with any capable adventurer regardless of Alliance or Horde ties.

angles.text: As a representative of the Violet Eye, Darius exemplifies Dalaran's enduring commitment to containing rogue sorceries and the dangerous fallout of Guardian Medivh's work.
